Name: Makenzie Mudd
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

Take a Line for a Walk could be used in my 8th grade ELA classroom. We spend a lot of time breaking down and annotating text, so this would be a good strategy to have students dive deeper into smaller portions of a text. It would be very impactful to use with poetry, as each line usually has a deeper meaning to the overall shorter text.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
We have used free writes before writing assignments to get student ideas flowing. It can be challenging at times because many students give the "I don't know where to start" comment so I have started giving a few sentence starter ideas on the board to help kickstart those students.
